Indirect calls are not resolved: device dispatch 0x1c4df0/0x1c4da0 under 0x1c2e68, allocator slots 0x213574..0x213580, the 0x178910 callback table, scheduler constructor/callback jalr, filter callbacks 0x2003b0 and the 0x1fe308 loader (=0x18f7a8 by ELF data). Every "not reached" statement is modulo these.
Storage readiness is asynchronous (card thread 0x16d918 / poll 0x16c2a0); the number of selector-3 ticks is not static. The contract fixes event order, not frame numbers.

GS register contents of the per-frame clear and draw packets (ZBUF.ZMSK, FBMSK, SCISSOR, env qword count) are not decoded; A00/A01 and A02 Z24 lanes are therefore conservatively invalidated, not modeled.

Glyph-cache transfers (0x197a98 -> 0x1976f0) happen only if text glyphs are queued; static reading does not prove no text is queued in storage/logo frames (12b508 -> 129388 message path, debug print paths).
Handle ids 36..43/44..110 and record indices 36..112 are derived with the Handle first-fit / FIFO semantics and the reservation order, not observed (Startup U03 continued).

Model instance table *0x21301c and model count 0x337ef0 are assumed inactive at both retirements: their only activator 0x1b8a80 is first reached at 0x12c7bc (after both retirements); writes through the heap pointer were not enumerated exhaustively.

Archive member lookup is case-insensitive (0x1bc700 lower-cases the query in place); that 0x1c2e68 reaches 0x1bc700 through the device dispatch jalr is inferred, so the five case-variant duplicate names resolve to the same member.

The material table 0x3301a4 (0x18-byte records: s16 texture, s16 palette level, s16 u/v modes, 4 floats) is read by 0x17be50 with this layout; that 0x182c90.. fill it from the XMD TextureState records is inferred.

The two startup embedded-model binding records (0x18e4c0 -> 183450(xmd, first=0), bound to handle 0 and its successors) stay in the 0x330144 list; NIGHT_V becomes the head record. Their exact name counts were not decoded here (outside the window).
RNG beyond 0x100618: 0x105a40 (rand at 0x10a558) is reachable from resource tick 0x1012a8; with no effect instance live in this window no draw is expected, but this is not proved.

Owner-window (0x178b50) entries during this window: per-frame 0x178310/0x179388, contended 0x179478 (0x183450) and allocator semaphore 0x1ce8c8 (0x1cf728). The worker thread then runs queued jobs with cls=1; no job post (0x178578) is reachable, so the queue stays empty (ELF 0x1fe244 == 0x1fe248 == 0).
